title: Total 542 Members of Parliament in India by Age Group

metric.name: Number of MPs
metric.description: Total number of MPs accounted for

insight: At the start of the 18th Lok Sabha in June 2024, there are 542 Members of Parliament in India, with the largest age group being 51–60 years old, accounting for 166 MPs. Interestingly, there are no MPs under 21, so if you're looking for youthful exuberance, you might have to settle for the 21–30 age group, which has just 7 members — basically, the Lok Sabha's version of a toddler's playgroup.
